description: Painted sprite parts for the patrol knight on his barded horse (?art=paint). Same three steps as paint-patrol-pawn.json: pose, parts sheet, background removal; then tools/art/cut-parts.mjs. The horse is part of the body; the lance stands upright in the front fist at the horse's flank, and rig-lance couches it.

steps.name: pose
steps.prompt: Full-body game sprite of the royal patrol KNIGHT from the first image, painted in the art style of the second image (a character select sheet). Use the third image only for the chunky proportions, the big helm and the lance standing upright on the left, not for its style; push the horse head further forward than in the third image. SUBJECT: a royal patrol knight riding a small chunky dark warhorse. HELM: a BIG rounded pale-steel armet helm like the first image: a domed crown and a visor that juts forward to a blunt point at the front, with ONE thin horizontal eye slit and two short vertical breath slits below it, no face visible, a hinge rivet on the side, a thin gold band at the neck. Not a flat-faced bucket helm and no T-shaped opening. The helm is the biggest single shape of the rider: about as wide as his shoulders and about a quarter of the whole figure's height. PLUME: one thick royal-blue plume rising from a gold holder on top of the helm, standing UP and curling FORWARD to the right over the visor, about as tall as the helm; all of it sits above the helm and the front half of the head, nothing behind the back of the helm, so it never touches the lance. ARMOUR: royal-blue breastplate, rounded royal-blue pauldrons with gold rims, steel gauntlets. He sits astride the horse, his near armoured thigh along the horse's back over a royal-blue saddle cloth with gold trim, a gold stirrup under his steel boot. HORSE: short and stocky, seen from the side facing right, a DARK charcoal-grey horse with dark gunmetal barding plates, clearly much darker than the rider's pale steel helm, a black mane, four short chunky legs with black hooves. Its neck stretches FORWARD and up to the right, and its head is BIG (about as big as the rider's helm) and sits well IN FRONT of the rider at the far right of the figure, with a wide gap of background between the horse's head and the rider's arm and chest: a clear horse head in profile like a chess knight piece, with a pale steel chanfron plate with a gold edge down its face, a round eye guard around a black dot eye, two pointed ears at the height of the rider's chin, the muzzle pointing right. LANCE: his right fist visibly grips a long lance held straight upright on the far LEFT side of the figure, beside the horse's rump, with a clear gap of background between the lance and the helm and plume: a THICK royal-blue shaft with gold rings, a steel cone guard (vamplate) just ABOVE his fist that opens upward toward the point, and a big steel leaf-shaped spear point at the top, higher than the top of the plume; he holds it near its bottom end, so only a very short butt shows below his fist. His left fist rests low on the saddle pommel in front of his belly, not reaching up to the horse's neck. Side view facing right, the whole horse and rider visible, chunky and big-headed: helm and plume together are about 40% of the figure's height. STYLE to match the second image exactly: bold flash-era 2D brawler cartoon, very thick even black outlines, flat fills, one hard cel shadow, crisp white highlights on metal, polished royal blue with gold trim, pale steel. One character only, centred, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8), no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no frame.

steps.name: parts
steps.prompt:
Cut this exact character into separate parts for a 2D cut-out puppet, like a paper-doll sprite sheet. Keep his exact art style, colours, outline thickness and shading. Draw each part whole and complete, including the bits that are normally hidden behind other parts, and give every part its own very thick black outline all the way round. The parts are separate stickers with wide empty gaps between them, every part at the same scale as in the first image, on a plain flat light grey background (#d8d8d8). The image holds only these parts and nothing else: no other characters, no tiles, no text, no labels, no numbers, no grid lines, no cast shadows, no black gaps or holes.

Layout, exactly:
- Top left: the HEAD: the big steel armet helm with its pointed visor, eye slit, breath slits and the forward-curling blue plume. It ends at the gold neck band, no neck.
- Middle, large: the BODY, facing RIGHT exactly as in the first image, the horse's head on the right and its tail on the left (do not mirror it): the whole dark horse in its dark barding with its forward-stretched head and neck, saddle cloth and legs, and the rider's royal-blue breastplate and leg sitting on it, with no arms, no pauldrons, no head and no lance; a short steel neck stump at the top of the rider.
- Top right: the BACK ARM (his left arm): a rounded blue gold-rimmed pauldron on top of a blue plate arm bent forward and down, ending in a closed steel gauntlet.
- Bottom left: the FRONT ARM (his right arm): a rounded blue gold-rimmed pauldron on top of a blue plate arm hanging down and a little back, ending in a big closed steel gauntlet fist.
- Right edge, spanning from top to bottom: the LANCE on its own, standing straight up, spear point at the top, the steel cone guard near the bottom opening upward, a thick shaft, whole and not held.
